name: Assisted Triceps Dip
steps: Set the counterweight on an assisted dip machine, grip the narrow handles with locked arms, and kneel carefully on the assistance pad.
Keep your torso upright, shoulders packed down, and elbows pointed straight behind you.
Bend your elbows close to your ribs to lower yourself smoothly until your upper arms reach roughly parallel.
Press firmly down through both hands to straighten your arms back to the top without locking violently.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked close to your sides to maintain focus on your triceps.
Stop descending before your shoulders roll forward or feel pinched.
